## Highlights

- Chain tasks after successful, failed, or completed runs, with durable replay and correlated history.
- Import, explain, edit, preview, and export a substantially broader set of five-field and six-field cron expressions.
- Preserve scheduling intent through daylight-saving transitions and run `@reboot` tasks once at scheduler startup.
- Use the complete go-schedule visual system across the desktop interface, installers, packages, and documentation.
- Operate with clearer activity diagnostics, safer local daemon access, and stronger release-maintenance checks.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v0.9.0/CHANGELOG.md#090---2026-08-30) for every change.
